name: Routing — APIM fronting Anthropic
summary: ApiManagement connection where the upstream is Anthropic's Messages API translated by an APIM policy.
description: Confirmed working via local notebook + foundry-samples APIM test script. Uses '{anthropic-apim-conn}/claude-opus-4-6' as the model prefix in a PromptAgentDefinition. Skips if AI_GATEWAY_CONNECTION_ANTHROPIC is unset.
notes: Requires APIM with a policy that translates OpenAI chat-completions → Anthropic Messages. See options-infra/ai-gateway-anthropic/ for a Bicep template.
